scope: Production engine, not browser pointer delivery

bots.name: repeat
bots.note: visible handle, same upward 104 px stroke
bots.chanceFormula: 80 rotations / 1800 rotations = 8° / 180°; endpoint constraints reduce this upper bound
bots.finitePoolCaveat: Mode-uniform pool weighted by first-attempt policy position; without-replacement exclusion of at most one earlier same-mode question changes the probability by at most 1/1799. Random coordinate input reports only the proven direction upper bound.
